name: The Name Behind the Work
why_it_works: Clients trust people, not logos. Spotlighting the staff member who does the invisible work (the paralegal, the hygienist, the dishwasher, the equipment manager) makes the business feel human and shows the client who is really taking care of them.

hook.pattern: Name the person and the invisible job in one line, as a tease.
examples: Our most important person isn't on the sign.
{{staff_name}} does the job nobody claps for.

variables.name: staff_name
variables.description: First name of the staff member (with consent)

variables.name: quirk
variables.description: One human detail they agreed to share
variables.example: keeps a cactus named Judge on the desk

variables.name: offer
variables.description: Next step for the viewer, a full sentence starting with a capital, 7 words or fewer

visual.prompt: Real photo of {{staff_name}}, the {{brand}} {{staff_role}}, from behind at their own desk, warm desk lamp, early light, shared with consent, vertical 9:16
Real phone footage of {{staff_name}} speaking to camera at their own desk in their own words, natural office light, chest-up, vertical 9:16
Close-up desk detail at {{brand}}: {{quirk}}, soft window light, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16

beats.voiceover: {{years}} years of doing it right when nobody's watching.

visual.prompt: Real candid photo of {{staff_name}} at work at {{brand}}, hands on keyboard and paperwork, side angle, no client details visible, vertical 9:16

craft.notes: Open without showing the face so the hook works as a tease, then let the real person speak in their own voice on their own footage. The quirk beat is what makes it shareable; pick one that is warm and specific, never a joke at their expense.

do_not: Feature anyone without their written consent to be filmed and posted
Show any client name, file or screen
Script words the staff member would not say themselves
compliance: Law firms: do not show case files or client info; no outcome guarantees; include required attorney advertising disclaimers per your state bar
Dental: no patient faces or charts on screen without HIPAA-compliant written authorization
Insurance: do not imply coverage or claim outcomes; include agency license info where required
Staff appear only in their own real photos and footage, with signed consent; never a generated likeness or clone
